items.stem: Why can optimising a single function harm the whole supply chain?

options.text: Local optimisation can shift cost or risk elsewhere and worsen end-to-end performance
options.rationale: Correct: the chain is a system; local wins can cause system losses.

options.text: The cheapest function is always best for the chain
options.rationale: Lowest local cost can raise total cost.

options.text: End-to-end thinking is only for finance
options.rationale: It applies across the whole chain.

items.explanation: Correct: local optimisation can shift cost or risk and worsen the end-to-end result.

options.rationale: Correct: more variability needs more safety stock for a given service level.

Safety stock is set by variability and service, not preference.
